za-: this (demonstrative pronoun/adjective; neuter nominative/accusative za, common accusative zan, dative zatti, genitival zassi)
=du: to him, to it (clitic pronoun, 3rd person singular dative; leans on an earlier word)
Azzattiwadaya-: Azatiwadaya — the city named after Azatiwada (written with the LITUUS sign and the city sign URBS)
appan: behind, after, afterwards (written with the POST sign; adverb/postposition)
Runti(ya)-: Runtiya (Runzas) — a god, the stag-god (written with the stag sign CERVUS₃)
[lost]: signs broken away on the stone; not restored
ta: a surviving sign of an unread word; no meaning recoverable
x: an illegible trace of a sign
i-zi-i-: the surviving start of a word the corpus leaves uninterpreted
=pa or =ha: a lost sign that the corpus reads as pa or ha — 'but' or 'and'; the reading is not settled
isnu(wa)-: settle, make sit (causative of 'sit'; written with the seat sign SOLIUM)
=an: him, it (clitic pronoun, 3rd person common-gender accusative singular; leans on an earlier word)
izzista-: honour, to honour (verb; the infinitive honours)
habad(i)-: river-land, riverine land (noun; classified by the river sign FLUMEN; the d may be sounded r)
-is: common-gender nominative singular ending (a variant spelling of -s, with i before the s)
uss(i)-: year (noun; classified by the ANNUS sign)
mari: during, throughout (postposition/adverb; written as one ligature ma+ra/i)
waw(i)-: bull, ox (noun; written with the sign BOS.ANIMA)
kwaruna-: cutting, harvest of a cutting (noun, written with the sign L486; meaning approximate)
haw(i)-: sheep (noun; written with the sign OVIS.ANIMA)
harr(a/i)-: crushing, pressing (noun, classified by the vine sign VITIS; meaning approximate)

saPisad(a)-: health (noun; the capital P marks a sound the spelling leaves open)
hadara-: health, well-being (noun; glossed alike with saPisad(a)-)
=as: he, she, it (clitic pronoun, 3rd person common-gender nominative singular)
-(ra)ru: 3rd person singular imperative ending, middle — 'let it/him be …' (the ra is optional in the spelling)
-ntu: 3rd person plural imperative ending, active — 'may they …' (the n is usually unwritten)
-mmi-: participle suffix — forms 'pleased, blessed, …-ed' adjectives from verbs
massan(i)-: god, deity (noun; written with the DEUS sign)
array(a/i)-: long (adjective; written with LONGUS, the l-sign standing for the stem's r)
miyant(i)-: many (adjective; the n before t is unwritten)
-sa: neuter nominative/accusative singular ending (in these nouns and adjectives)
pihass(a)-: aura, radiance (noun, written with the lightning sign FULGUR; nuance approximate)
-ru: 3rd person singular imperative ending, middle — 'may it be …'
Kumarma-: Kumarma — a god (divine name; written with the DEUS and BONUS signs)
-s(sa): genitive singular ending — 'of …' (the -sa part is often left unwritten)
TiPariya-: Tipariya — a god (divine name; written with the DEUS and vine sign VITIS)
wattani-: country, land (noun; written with the REGIO sign)
man: much, greatly (adverb; the n is unwritten)
=anza: us, to us (clitic pronoun, 1st person plural dative)
urannu(wa)-: magnify, make great (verb; causative of ura- 'great', written with MAGNUS)
parnawa-: serve (verb; written with the CRUX sign, as part of the house sign)
